title: The unknotting numbers for plus-welded knotoids
summary: Knotoid theory is a generalization of knot theory introduced by Turaev in 2012. In recent years, various invariants of knotoids have been studied. In this paper, we mainly discuss unknotting moves and unknotting numbers of plus-welded knotoids. Firstly, we prove that a descending diagram of a plus-welded knotoid can be transformed into a trivial one through a finite sequence of $Ω_1$, $VΩ_1 - VΩ_4$, $Ω_v$, $Φ_{\text{over}}$, and $Φ_+$-moves.
